title: Thirdway journal
description: A big section heading with a 'view all' link, over three ink-veil post cards (3:2 cover, three circled date figures, a 20px title). On phones and tablets the cards are a snap carousel with round arrows and the link sits below; from xl they form a 6 / 3 / 3 grid whose first card is large. Covers zoom 4% on hover.
notes: the carousel arrows need JavaScript (hydrate: visible); from lg up the track becomes a grid and the arrows hide
